observations.behavior: Adds a Django management command that, given a list of team IDs, discovers active feature flags whose cohorts have been deleted, and either prints a dry-run report or creates and sends in-app notifications to relevant team members.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides an administrative CLI entry point for teams and support to discover and remediate a specific failure mode: feature flags still active after their cohort dependency was removed. This could help prevent configuration drift or unexpected behavior when cohorts are deleted, though the actual remediation and delivery depend on the imported helper and notification infrastructure.
